quotes.title: LP 890-9
quotes.card: LP 890-9 is a red dwarf star located 105 light-years (32 pc) away from the Solar System in the constellation of Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: The star has 12% the mass and 15% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of 2,871 K. It is extremely faint and, with an apparent magnitude of 18, is the faintest star with exoplanets discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).
